prompts.pose: Edit the attached cute brown baby-monkey illustration. Change the raised pointing arm: extend it toward the viewer's RIGHT side, with the index finger clearly pointing horizontally RIGHT, not up. Let the eyes glance toward that finger on the right. Keep the other hand resting on the lap. Keep the curled brown tail attached behind the right hip, fully visible on the right, separated from the hand and body silhouette enough for animation. Keep full figure and finger inside a square canvas with generous transparent padding on all sides. Truly transparent background, no black background, no ground, no shadow, no button, no glass shape, no text or arrows. Single character only. This is a cutout asset for placement beside a separately built liquid-glass button.
